response.sql:
WITH patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(GOT) AS avg_got,
    AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_got) AS mean_got
  FROM patient_avgs
)
SELECT 
  pa.ID,
  pa.avg_got,
  pa.avg_rbc,
  pa.avg_got - om.mean_got AS difference
FROM patient_avgs pa
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE om.mean_got IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  difference IS NULL,
  difference DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Ignore missing values in all averages" uses standard SQL AVG() semantics, which excludes NULL values from each individual average calculation (not excluding entire patients with any missing values).
